messages.subject: no slot of name ... when using imputed data in semTools runMI
parts:
Other references to this error suggest that the data argument is not formatted properly, but I think my list is correct. Any ideas for troubleshooting? What does "no slot" mean?


# get list of imputed datasets
miList <- list()
  for (i in 1:20) { # 20 imputed datasets
    miList[[i]] <- complete(x=x, action=i, include=FALSE)
  }

# use imputed data
# v <-  # vector of column names to use
mod <- paste("total", "=~", paste(v, collapse="+"))
fit <- runMI(mod, data = miList, estimator = "WLSMV", fun="cfa")

# when trying to inspect fit
no slot of name "fit" for this object of class "lavaanStar"

Hi Henriette,

I use this example to test the multiple imputation for categorical items and it seems to work well. Can you check are there any differences between yours and me?

f1 =~ 0.7*y1 + 0.7*y2 + 0.7*y3 + 0.7*y4
f1 ~~ 1*f1
y1 | 0.5*t1
y2 | 0.25*t1
y3 | 0*t1
y4 | -0.5*t1
"

analyzeModel <- "
f1 =~ y1 + y2 + y3 + y4
"

dat <- simulateData(popModel, sample.nobs  = 200L)
miss.pat <- matrix(as.logical(rbinom(prod(dim(dat)), 1, 0.2)), nrow(dat), ncol(dat))
dat[miss.pat] <- NA
out5 <- cfa.mi(analyzeModel, data=dat, ordered=paste0("y", 1:4), m = 3, miArgs=list(ords = c("y1", "y2", "y3", "y4")))
summary(out5)
inspect(out5, "fit")
inspect(out5, "impute")


Best,
Sunthud
